distribution.narrative: Liao et al. (2022) provides the first mainland-China records from Sichuan and Yunnan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently documents the prior Taiwan occurrence.

host_note: Carya cathayensis is direct host-label evidence from Yunnan material in Liao et al. (2022). Beaver & Liu (2010) records Diospyros, Ficus, Styrax and Wendlandia in Taiwan; these are added at genus level. General polyphagy is retained as context only.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytoplatypus pubescens Hagedorn, 1904.

taxonomic_history.name: Scolytoplatypus pubescens kabakovi

nomenclature_note: Current identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone and Liao et al. (2022): Scolytoplatypus pubescens Hagedorn, 1904, VSN_5435. Beaver & Liu (2010) provides earlier Taiwan/host evidence and does not override the later revision.
